cases.name: CHK-003 adversarial: regression would fail if any of the last three high lines returned
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const raw = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js', 'gap_analyze'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8' }); const json = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))); const highs = new Set(json.gaps.filter((g) => g.severity === 'high').map((g) => `${g.source?.file}:${g.source?.line}`)); return { noFramework5: !highs.has('decisions/framework.md:5'), noFramework8: !highs.has('decisions/framework.md:8'), noWave0: !highs.has('decisions/role-separation.md:897') };
